<!-- repository-audit-2026-10-08 -->
## Current repository state — October 8, 2026

Python assembly, dependency pins, fingerprints and regression controls are merged. This audit removes private host font lookup and GNU-only realpath, and adds Python CI with no skipped tests. The historical offline proof covers fd73cbcd, not the current engine. The current-tree offline probe remains required.

**Additional verified portability fix:** Pillow BASIC measurement is now explicit in the engine and independent metric probes; optional RAQM availability no longer changes the established results. The hosted Linux Python job passed on `42ce598` ([run](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/actions/runs/37802579281)). This does not establish complex-script/Skia glyph parity or offline Python-container qualification.

[Verified repository audit and priorities](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/repository-audit-2026-10-08.md) · [Python setup](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/README.md) · [Official starter](https://github.com/jhaaj08/chameleon/tree/a44a06046b0413f0785e7203955c3822e0acbc32).

Adobe's direct brief/starter and launch communication were rechecked; no new starter revision or changed technical rule was found. Dates remain team registration October 8, submission October 30, finalists November 23, finale January 11–13. Team registration status and exact cutoff timezone remain unverified. This status supersedes old paused-worker/migration-pending statements and elapsed run cutoffs below; it does not restart channels or close acceptance gates. Existing ownership and checklists are preserved.

---

<!-- python-migration-2026-10-06 -->
**Historical migration decision (October 6):** user selected pure Python using Adobe’s starter entrypoint, not a TypeScript subprocess bridge. Follow [the staged migration plan](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/jo/python-migration-plan-2026-10-06/docs/plans/2026-10-06-python-migration.md). Preserve useful existing behavior/tests; qualify real rendering, protected fields and offline reproduction before retiring the legacy submission path. Existing 08:30 AM Eastern run cutoff remains; this notice does not assert implementation or acceptance.

<!-- adobe-source-sync-2026-10-05-launch -->
## Historical Adobe launch snapshot — October 5, 2026

[Source audit](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/jo/adobe-source-sync-2026-10-05/docs/evidence/2026-10-05-adobe-launch/README.md) · [Current roadmap](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/jo/adobe-source-sync-2026-10-05/docs/roadmap-2026-10-05.md) · [Next paused plan](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/jo/adobe-source-sync-2026-10-05/docs/plans/2026-10-05-adobe-execution.md) · [Official starter](https://github.com/jhaaj08/chameleon/tree/a44a06046b0413f0785e7203955c3822e0acbc32).

Adobe's latest launch email and linked Final Chameleon Challenge govern this update. Pinned upstream remains `a44a06046b0413f0785e7203955c3822e0acbc32`; source availability is verified, runtime rendering/qualification is not. Reflow is explicitly paused pending source-aligned restart.

A4: reproduce the official Python linux/amd64 container with build-time dependencies and network-disabled runtime. Existing internal CLI/container tests remain valid for their scope, not evidence that official Python JSON/PNG contract is met. Do not remove internal safety budgets or assert organizer timing limits.

No issue is closed, reassigned or marked complete by this source reconciliation. Historical evidence and unchecked implementation gates below remain; conflicting older requirements are superseded by the source audit and unresolved-source register.

---

### Historical context and existing acceptance

<!-- roadmap-reconciliation-2026-09-26 -->
## Current scope — September 26, 2026

[Current roadmap](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-26.md) · [Official versions/conflicts](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-26-issue4/competition-contract.md). This amendment supersedes conflicting qualification assumptions in the older sections below; existing implementation evidence and uncompleted checks remain. No closure is claimed.

**P0 offline reliability/compatibility continues.** The official-linked provisional Python/container/schema path is now inspectable through #4. Current RULES have no hard Stage 1 execution-time limit: keep internal timeout/byte/memory safeguards, but do not label them organizer limits. Exact reference allocations/model rules and M5 Pro versus amd64 execution remain unsettled. Qualify full parse/resources/engine/real-renderer/export costs, networking disabled and second-environment reproduction. Native Express sign-in is not an offline CLI dependency.

---

## Earlier scope and evidence

**Owner:** @ojedaJD — Engine
**Priority:** P0 — qualification compatibility, evaluation and execution
**Dependencies:** #2, #3. Start implementation after these interfaces/findings are available.

## Why

The prototype runs locally, but there is no submission-style offline invocation or container yet. A reproducible internal harness can expose dependency and failure-handling problems early.

## Scope

Add a documented command that accepts the internal design plus target dimensions and returns editable output with diagnostics. Package the required fonts/assets/runtime in a container. Keep the eventual official input/output adapter separate and label this harness provisional.

## Work area

- `scripts/ (CLI entry point)`
- `package.json`
- `Dockerfile (new)`
- `README.md`

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] A fresh documented container build can run representative fixtures with network access disabled after build-time dependencies are installed.
- [ ] Repeated runs preserve equivalent layout/content apart from explicit timing metadata; outputs retain traceable IDs.
- [ ] Invalid input, missing assets/fonts, and extreme/infeasible sizes return explicit errors or findings without a hung process or silent content loss.
- [ ] Record invocation, image/runtime versions, sample I/O, exit behavior, runtime/memory observations, and remaining official-contract blockers.

## Handoff

Krush reproduces the documented command and container run; Junho verifies bundled font/render behavior.

Link the implementation commit, plan and verification evidence here; a PR and teammate review are optional. Coordinate shared-file changes before editing.

## Context

[Team plan](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/team-plan.md) · [Current status](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/progress.md) · [Benchmark gallery](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-15/gallery.md)

## Adversarial review follow-up — September 15, 2026

[Review and reproduced evidence](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/adversarial-review.md). These are open acceptance requirements, not fixes already delivered.

- [ ] Add an external execution timeout and document memory/resource limits against the released contract. Keep prototype limits explicitly provisional.
- [ ] Reproduce `npm run review:stress` (single recorded 100-element dense-text case: 28.09 s). Measure representative inputs separately; do not describe this as typical latency or p95.
- [ ] Record cold start, fonts/assets, parse, layout, render/export, memory and failure behavior. Cache repeat measurements/results, bound candidate search, and expose unresolved findings in fallback output.
- [ ] Demonstrate a clean-machine, network-disabled run and defined behavior for malformed/infeasible input and timeout. Coordinate browser cancellation/cached redraw with #9 and the CI follow-up.

## Competitive research implementation update — September 15, 2026

[Research and sources](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/competitive-research-2026-09-15.md) · [Issue-sync plan](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/plans/research-issue-sync.md)

### Submission capacity and bounded execution — P0

- [ ] Integrate #4's authoritative input/model/dependency/runtime contract when released; label interim bounds provisional. Exercise supported extremes and invalid inputs without silent truncation or content loss.
- [ ] Record cold/warm load, parse, font/asset setup, layout, render/export, peak memory, timeout and fallback outcomes across representative and difficult cases. One 28-second stress run is not a latency distribution.
- [ ] Enforce operation/candidate/repair budgets, cancellation and a completed fallback with unresolved findings visible. Cache repeated measurements and skip duplicate candidates; coordinate #5/#9.
- [ ] Reproduce from a clean checkout/container with network disabled and documented fonts/assets on a teammate's machine. #13 runs an appropriate smoke check on pushes to main.
- [ ] Profile before selecting an optimization or language port; justify any Rust component with measured end-to-end gain and preserved output behavior. A rewrite is not a prerequisite.

Implementation follows [the development workflow](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/development-workflow.md): plan/problem/risks first, meaningful failing behavioral tests before code, then the required verification. Documentation work uses content/link checks. Direct commits to main are the default; optional branches use `jo/`, and PR/reviewer approval is optional.

## Quality/ML handoff — September 16, 2026

[Quality/ML strategy](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/quality-and-ml.md) · [Planning record](https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/plans/quality-ml-roadmap.md) · ML experiment #19

- [ ] Reserve and measure an optional local-ranking stage budget for #19 only after #4 verifies model rules. Include weights/dependency availability, cold load, input rendering, inference, cancellation and output rendering in end-to-end runtime/memory evidence.
- [ ] Test absent/crashed/timed-out models, malformed ranker output and zero-valid-candidate behavior before integration. An external worker/process deadline must actually stop inference; log deterministic valid fallback or explicit failure.
- [ ] Keep the current engine runnable without a model or network; extend CI with model-path checks only when that path exists. This does not reopen completed #13 or erase the completed measurement-reuse slice.


## September 22 completion boundaries and follow-ups
#23 and #24 are closed; the provisional CLI/container and hosted network-disabled smoke gate are landed. Full acceptance above remains. [Roadmap](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-22.md).

#25 preserves UTF-8 across output chunks; #26 rejects structurally invalid successful outputs; #27 rejects invalid text measurements. JD owns those finite fixes. #28/#30 coordinate viewer cancellation and production offline budgets; #33 adds actual external-corpus runs; #35 is the dependency-gated release rehearsal.

Remaining profiling here must cover parent startup/read, parse/resources, layout, render/export, whole-process/container memory and failure costs with representative sample counts, cold/warm distributions and worst cases. Test provisional bounds below/at/above the limit, visible timeout/OOM and source retention. Worker-only timing is not complete end-to-end latency. Keep resource limits until #4 verifies official constraints; do not silently remove bounds for coverage. Independent teammate reproduction remains required.

<!-- october-13-packets -->
## October 13 finite work queue

This issue remains the acceptance tracker; its original scope and owner are preserved. Pick up the child packets instead of claiming this entire umbrella. A child completion does not close this parent.

- [ ] #99 — Qualify the Python image on hosted Docker (Offline Engineer 2)

[Run plan and ownership](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/execution/2026-10-13/README.md). Channels drain October 13 at 08:00 Eastern and stop at 08:30 Eastern.

comments.body:
Starting a bounded engine-owned slice of #8: profile repeated font-measurement requests, then add a per-reflow cache with bounded retained entries/query text if justified. Plan: docs/plans/measurement-cache.md (will be linked at the implementation commit). Tests-first regression on 0757de5 currently fails because 36 duplicate requests reach the measurer; fresh-font-state and invalid-input controls pass.

#3 remains open with no font-parity handoff. This slice preserves Measure/reflow/Result signatures and leaves src/typography.ts, src/render.ts, scripts/native.ts, fixtures and browser checks untouched. It does not finish the dependent CLI/container work or provide execution deadlines, cancellation, fallback, offline/official-contract certification, or teammate reproduction. #8 stays open. Existing #5/#12 scope and #4/#7 dependencies remain unchanged.

Initial repository health: main is current, and the notes-only 0757de5 hosted run succeeded: https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/actions/runs/35090889429 . Direct validated commits to main, with required local/rendered/hosted evidence, will follow.

Profiling refined the slice before implementation: the 100-element dense case made 465,300 native requests, with 54,700 repeats within immutable element contexts. The no-image/text-partition path also repeats the same entire stack arrangement for split. The scoped implementation caches per-call repeated measurements and reuses completed equivalent arrangements while preserving independent public stack/split entries. It keeps all existing interfaces and candidate contents.

Recorded behavioral red before production changes: 2 failures / 3 passing controls (36 duplicate requests; 85 repeated equivalent-arrangement measurement contexts). After implementation, 18 focused tests and 178 total tests pass. Full native/output/rendered/hosted evidence is still in progress; no broader #8 acceptance is claimed.

Completed this engine-owned slice on main: implementation 90bc454dca9da3cd8bec563718faa928332f82a1; reviewed evidence 1f8ae8b.

Problem/result: repeated native measurements and identical stack/split work consumed unnecessary time. Reflow now caches queries within immutable element contexts for one operation (4,096 entries / 262,144 UTF-16 query units maximum) and copies completed equivalent candidates. All existing interfaces, candidate entries, content and findings are preserved.

Plan: https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/plans/measurement-cache.md
Evidence, both runtime runs, full limitations and reproduction: https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-16-measurement-cache/README.md
Hosted implementation CI passed, including real Chromium acceptance: https://github.com/ojedaJD/reflow-studio/actions/runs/35092538387

Test-first evidence: 2 intended failures / 3 controls before production edits (36 redundant requests; 85 repeated equivalent-arrangement contexts). Final validation: 178 tests, build, 30 native cases, benchmark, 11/11 connected-browser checks and hosted Chromium pass. All 70 JSONs and 70 PNGs match the prior archives; baseline/selected warnings remain 42/11. Reviewed badge, serif, dense, product and sparse output.

Both paired native comparisons preserve all 94 complete results except timing. Fixture calls fell 112,050→70,260 over 90 pairs; dense-100 calls fell 465,300→227,000. Final dense observation: 30.864→15.180s, retaining all 100 readability warnings. Timings vary; this is not a deadline, p95, process-memory bound or independent quality result.

#8 remains open / In progress. CLI/container, network-disabled and teammate reproduction, deadlines, cancellation/fallback, full load/parse/render/peak-memory profiling and official limits remain. #3 still has no font-parity handoff; #4/#7 integration/independent evidence and partial #5/#12 scope are unchanged. No teammate-owned typography/rendering/fixture files changed. Existing verification skills and the new comparison script cover repeat work, so no new skill was warranted. Direct-main and jo/ optional-branch preferences remain in force.

Completed a bounded #8 CLI/container slice on `main` in commit [`63393d5`](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/commit/63393d58a4c6f2ccdb83caf8a28fffe421d77260). This was rebased onto the separately landed #5 commit `ffe9b93`; no engine, ranking, typography or resource contracts were changed by this slice.

- [Plan and test-first record](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/plans/offline-cli-container.md) · [reviewed container evidence and sample I/O](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-22-offline-cli/README.md) · [documented command](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/README.md#provisional-offline-command).
- The provisional `reflow.design.v0` command returns selected editable JSON, diagnostics and timing/memory observations. Invalid JSON, target arguments, oversized input and unavailable bundled fonts/assets return structured nonzero errors. A supervisor kills the worker at a provisional wall-clock deadline; timeout exits 124 with no partial output. The container packages locked dependencies and bundled fonts/assets.
- Process tests were authored first. The initial 3/3 failures showed the missing CLI entry point (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`), which established interface absence but was not a behavioral red for validation/timeout. Final process tests exercise those behaviors directly, including a dense synchronous timeout and a valid image/extreme-size control.
- Local validation after rebasing: 264 tests, build, 30 native layouts, benchmark, and browser acceptance passed. Podman built the Dockerfile and ran all ten authored fixtures with `--network none`; complete element ID sets were retained, zero detected hard errors, seven zero-warning and three one-warning cases. Repeated example output was identical excluding `timing`. A 500 ms deadline killed the dense 100-element worker; malformed JSON and missing font/asset cases returned exit 2. The dated evidence records image/Node versions, invocation, per-case wall time and worker RSS, sample output and exact limitations. Docker Desktop's daemon was unavailable, so Podman executed the Dockerfile.

Hosted CI passed: https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/actions/runs/35758086591

#8 stays open. Official Adobe schema/rules and limits, independent output quality, teammate clean-machine reproduction, broader performance distributions, model-path checks and browser cancellation remain unverified. Existing verification skills and repository workflow cover this repeatable procedure; no new skill was warranted.

Current-source operational evidence now applies to exact main `b7e8eab86df265580fa3ffab9ccda335ee8f6ef3`: [final integrated Python image run](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/actions/runs/38771709612) succeeded and was independently audited. [Committed matrix/resource evidence](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/b7e8eab86df265580fa3ffab9ccda335ee8f6ef3/docs/evidence/2026-10-15-offline-matrix/README.md). The older user-namespace-blocked status is historical; it is not the current image-proof state.

Added six actual container cases: valid fixture, malformed JSON, unsupported element, invalid target, injected parent/child timeout and bounded allocation/OOM. Actual image/identity/network/read-only input/hash/stopped-state/cleanup evidence is retained. The corrected OOM oracle requires a fresh own-cgroup oom_kill increment, exact limit/token/PID bindings, childSIGKILL and safe-allocation positive control; arbitrary exit137 is insufficient. Prior failed runs remain in the evidence history.

The bounded resource pilot covers five fresh-process and ten same-process runs, with real rendering and matching six-file output hashes. Full source/image/input/fingerprint/resource raw receipts were independently checked. These injected containment cases are not natural workload performance, and small descriptive timings are not percentiles, cold-machine or worst-case guarantees.

#8 and parent#35 remain OPEN. Remaining requirements include representative dense/extreme and phase/resource-budget evidence, real named-teammate second-environment reproduction, and applicable native/organizer acceptance. Optional model-path criteria activate only if a model is actually adopted. Next owner prepares the specific missing workload/reproduction packet, not a repeat of the already-passing unchanged image.
